blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Deep vision models often degrade under distribution shift. While test-time adaptation improves robustness by updating model parameters during inference, it typically requires iterative optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and multiple forward backward passes. We propose Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA) , a closed-form method that improves robustness under covariate shift without modifying model parameters.
Our key insight is that distribution shift induces geometric distortions in feature space. ZFGA estimates the Fisher information matrix of the predictive distribution with respect to feature embeddings and applies a linear transformation that aligns the Fisher geometry of test features with a reference geometry computed from clean data. This can be viewed as a natural-gradient-inspired preconditioning step in feature space.
We evaluate ZFGA on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C using ResNet-50 , DINO ViT-S/16, and CLIP ViT-B/32. ZFGA yields small but consistent improvements, with gains increasing as model robustness decreases. ZFGA is significantly better than zero-shot inference on all three models, but is not the strongest method on every individual model: covariance whitening yields a larger gain on ResNet-50, and Fisher whitening is statistically indistinguishable from ZFGA on CLIP. Comparing against six alternative training-free and gradient-based methods (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, AdaNPC), ZFGA is the only one that is non-negative across all three model families, while every other method substantially harms at least one. A weak positive correlation between Fisher geometry distortion and ZFGA gain (Pearson r = 0.366 r=0.366 , p = 0.017 p=0.017 ) provides preliminary evidence that geometric misalignment contributes to robustness degradation. Requiring only forward passes and matrix operations at inference time, ZFGA offers a lightweight, deterministic, and reliably non-harmful alternative to optimization-based test-time adaptation, albeit with smaller gains on highly robust models.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern vision systems are typically trained under the assumption that training and deployment data follow the same distribution. In practice, however, this assumption rarely holds. Real-world deployment often introduces covariate shift , where the input distribution changes while the conditional label distribution remains stable Quiñonero-Candela et al. (2008) ; Sugiyama et al. (2007) . Such distribution shifts arise from variations in lighting, sensor noise, weather conditions, and domain changes, and can significantly degrade the performance of machine learning models. Addressing distribution shift is therefore a central challenge for reliable computer vision systems.
blocks.zh: 现代愿景系统的培训通常假定培训和部署数据遵循同样的分布。 但在实践中,这种假设很少存在。 现实世界部署经常引入共变变换,输入分布发生变化,而有条件的标签分布保持稳定的Quiñonero-Candela等人(2008年);Sugiyama等人(2007年)。 这种分布变化源于照明、感应噪音、天气条件和域位变化的变化,并可显著降低机器学习模型的性能。 因此,解决分配转移问题是可靠的计算机视觉系统面临的一个中心挑战。

blocks.en: A large body of work has studied methods for handling distribution shift through domain adaptation and test-time adaptation. Traditional approaches estimate density ratios or reweight training samples to correct for covariate shift Sugiyama et al. (2007) ; Shimodaira (2000) . More recently, deep learning methods perform test-time adaptation by updating model parameters during inference using unlabeled target data Wang et al. (2020) ; Sun et al. (2020) . These approaches often rely on entropy minimization, self-training, or feature normalization to adapt models online. While effective, they require gradient-based optimization at test time, introducing additional computational cost, instability, and hyperparameter sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 大量工作研究了通过域位适应和测试时间适应处理分布转移的方法. 传统方法估计密度比率或重新加权培训样本,以纠正共同变异变化的Sugiyama等人(2007年);Shimodaira(2000年)。 最近,深层学习方法通过利用未贴标签的目标数据Wang等人(2020年)在推论中更新模型参数来进行测试时间适应;Sun等人(2020年). 这些方法往往依靠最小化,自我培训,或以正常化为特征,在网上调整模型。 它们虽然有效,但要求在试验时进行梯度优化,引入额外的计算成本、不稳定性和超参数灵敏度。

blocks.en: The emergence of large pre-trained foundation models has partially alleviated the distribution shift problem. Models such as CLIP Radford et al. (2021) and self-supervised vision transformers Caron et al. (2021) exhibit remarkable robustness to many distribution shifts due to large-scale pretraining. However, even these models suffer measurable performance degradation when evaluated under corrupted or shifted inputs Hendrycks and Dietterich (2019) ; Taori et al. (2020) . Existing adaptation methods designed for smaller supervised models may also interfere with the carefully learned feature geometry of these foundation models, sometimes leading to catastrophic performance drops.
blocks.zh: 大型预训基础模型的出现,部分缓解了分配转移问题. CLIP Radford等人(2021年)和自行监管的视变器Caron等人等型号. (2021年)由于大规模预训,许多分配班次表现出显著的稳健性. 然而,在对Hendrycks和Dietrich的投入进行腐败或转移评估时(2019年);Taori等人(2020年),即使这些模型也遭受了可衡量的性能退化。 为较小的受监督模型设计的现有适应方法也可能会干扰这些基础模型精心学习的特征几何,有时会导致灾难性的性能下降.

blocks.en: Recent studies suggest that robustness to distribution shift may be related to the geometry of feature representations . When input distributions change, the structure of embeddings produced by the model can become distorted, plausibly affecting the geometry of decision boundaries in feature space Amari (1998) . Standard normalization or covariance whitening methods attempt to correct such distortions but ignore the predictive structure of the classifier, which may destroy the similarity relationships learned during pretraining. Consequently, naive feature transformations can significantly harm performance in models relying on cosine similarity or prototype-based classifiers, as we confirm empirically in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 最近的研究表明,对分布转变的稳健性可能与特征表示的几何性有关。 当输入分布发生变化时,模型产生的嵌入结构会变得扭曲,对特征空间Amari(1998年)中决定边界的几何影响很合理. 标准正常化或共变白化方法试图纠正这种扭曲,但忽略了分类器的预测结构,这可能会破坏在预训中了解到的相似性关系. 因此,天真特征转换会大大损害依赖余弦相似性或原型分类器的模型的性能,我们在第4.2节中以经验方式证实了这一点。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a different perspective: rather than adapting model parameters or performing generic feature normalization, we correct the information geometry of the predictive distribution at inference time. Our key observation is that the Fisher information matrix of the classifier with respect to feature embeddings provides a natural metric that captures the local curvature of the predictive manifold Amari (1998) . Under covariate shift, distortions in the feature distribution manifest as changes in this Fisher geometry. By estimating the Fisher information matrix from unlabeled test data and aligning it with a reference geometry obtained from the training distribution, we can correct these distortions without modifying model parameters.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了不同的视角:我们不是调整模型参数或实现通用特征正常化,而是在推论时间纠正预测分布的信息几何. 我们的主要观察是,分类器关于特征嵌入的Fisher信息矩阵提供了一个自然的衡量尺度,它能够捕捉到预测多倍体Amari的局部曲率(1998年)。 在共变变化下,特征分布的扭曲表现为这个费舍尔几何学的变化. 通过从无标签的测试数据中估算费舍尔信息矩阵,并将其与从训练分布中获得的参考几何相匹配,我们可以在不修改模型参数的情况下纠正这些扭曲.

blocks.en: We introduce Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA) 1 , a simple inference-time procedure that aligns the Fisher geometry of test features with that of the training distribution. ZFGA computes a linear transformation derived from the empirical Fisher matrices of the reference and test distributions and applies it directly to feature embeddings before classification. The resulting transformation can be interpreted as a natural-gradient preconditioning step applied in feature space, correcting anisotropic curvature introduced by distribution shift while preserving the classifier structure.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了零训练费舍尔几何对齐(ZFGA) 1,这是一种简单的推论时间程序,将费舍尔几何测试特征与训练分布特征一致. ZFGA计算出从参考物和测试分布的实证费舍尔矩阵中得出的线性转变,并将其直接应用于分类前的特征嵌入. 由此形成的转变可以解释为在特征空间中应用的自然梯度前提步骤,纠正分配偏移引入的异位曲面,同时保留分类结构.

blocks.en: Unlike existing test-time adaptation methods, ZFGA requires no optimization, no gradient updates, and no additional training . It only uses forward passes and matrix operations, making it computationally efficient and deterministic. Importantly, the transformation respects the predictive geometry of the model, avoiding the catastrophic failures observed with standard covariance whitening on modern vision–language models.
blocks.zh: 与现有的测试时间适应方法不同,ZFGA不需要优化,没有梯度更新,也没有额外的训练. . 它只使用前方通行证和矩阵操作,使其在计算上高效和具有决定性。 重要的是,转变尊重模型的预测几何,避免了现代视觉-语言模型上标准共性白化所观察到的灾难性失败。

blocks.en: We evaluate ZFGA on CIFAR-10-C Hendrycks and Dietterich (2019) across models with different robustness levels, including supervised ResNet-50 He et al. (2016) , self-supervised DINOv3 ViT-S/16 Siméoni et al. (2025) , and the vision–language model CLIP ViT-B/32 Radford et al. (2021) , and validate the resulting trends on a subset of ImageNet-C Hendrycks and Dietterich (2019) . Our experiments reveal a consistent qualitative pattern: ZFGA provides the largest improvements for models lacking inherent robustness, while offering smaller, and on CLIP statistically inconclusive, gains for strong foundation models. Through geometric diagnostics, we further show that ZFGA effectiveness is weakly correlated with the magnitude of Fisher geometry distortion induced by distribution shift, and we discuss the limits of this evidence explicitly.
blocks.zh: 我们在CIFAR-10-C Hendrycks和Dietrich(2019年)上对ZFGA进行了不同强性水平的模型的评价,包括监督的ResNet-50 He等人(2016年)、自我监督的DINOv3 ViT-S/16 Siméoni等人(2025年)和愿景-语言模型CLIP ViT-B/32 Radford等人(2021年),并验证了由此产生的ImageNet-C Hendrycks和Dietrich子集的趋势(2019年)。 我们的实验揭示了一贯的质量模式:ZFGA为缺乏内在坚固性的模型提供了最大的改进,同时在CLIP统计学上为强大的基础模型提供了较小的改进,并且在CLIP上没有定论. 通过几何诊断,我们进一步表明,ZFGA的有效性与分布转移引起的费舍尔几何扭曲的程度有微弱的关联,我们明确讨论了这种证据的局限性.

blocks.en: Contributions
blocks.zh: 捐款

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: 1. We introduce a new perspective on test-time robustness by framing distribution shift as a distortion of the Fisher information geometry of feature representations. 2. We propose Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA) , an inference time method that corrects geometric distortion using Fisher matrix alignment without gradient-based adaptation. 3. We provide theoretical interpretation linking Fisher whitening to natural-gradient geometry and second-order approximations of predictive divergence. 4. Through experiments across supervised, self-supervised, and vision-language models on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C, we show that ZFGA is reliably safe (never catastrophically harmful, unlike naive covariance whitening) and provides small, model-robustness-dependent gains under moderate covariate shift, while preserving the structure of pretrained feature spaces. 5. We compare ZFGA against six training-free/backprop-free and gradient-based alternatives (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, AdaNPC) and show that, while ZFGA is rarely the single best performer per model, it is the only method that avoids harming any of the three model families tested.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们从新的角度看待试验时间的稳健性,将分布变化定为扭曲费舍尔信息几何特征表述。 2. 我们提议采用零训练费舍尔几何校正法(ZFGA),这种推论时间法采用费舍尔矩阵校正几何扭曲,而不采用梯度调整法。 3. 我们提供理论解释,将费舍尔白化与自然梯度几何和预测差异的二阶近似值联系起来。 4. 通过在CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C上跨过监督、自我监督、和视觉语言模型的实验,我们显示ZFGA是可靠的安全(绝非灾难性的危害,与天真的共变白化不同),在中度共变变化下提供小的、依赖模型的增益,同时保留预先训练的特征空间结构。 5. 我们比较了ZFGA与6种无培训/无背丙和梯度型替代品(共变白法、Fisher白法、TENT、T3A、LAME、AdaNPC),并表明,虽然ZFGA很少是每个模型中唯一的最佳表现者,但这是避免伤害三个模型家庭中任何一个的唯一方法。

blocks.en: Our results suggest that distribution shift may, in part, induce geometric distortions that are separable from fundamental representation failure, though our evidence for this is correlational and the effect sizes we observe are modest. Correcting this geometry through Fisher alignment offers a lightweight, training-free, and safe-by-construction alternative to traditional test-time adaptation methods, at the cost of smaller gains than gradient-based methods in the regimes where those methods remain stable.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,分配的转变可能部分地引起几何扭曲,而这种扭曲与基本的表达失败是分开的,尽管我们对此的证据是相互关联的,我们观察到的影响大小不大。 通过Fisher调整来纠正这种几何学,提供了一种轻量级、无培训和安全施工的替代传统试验时间调整方法,其代价是这些方法保持稳定的制度中收益比梯度法少。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Distribution Shift and Covariate Shift: Machine learning models typically assume that training and test data are drawn from the same distribution. In real-world applications this assumption is frequently violated, leading to dataset shift Quiñonero-Candela et al. (2008) . One common form is covariate shift , where the input distribution changes while the conditional label distribution remains invariant Shimodaira (2000) ; Sugiyama et al. (2007) . Covariate shift has been widely studied in statistical learning theory and practical machine learning systems, with approaches including importance weighting, density ratio estimation, and domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 分布式Shift和Covariate Shift:机器学习模型通常假设培训和测试数据来自相同的分布. 在现实世界的应用中,这种假设经常被违反,导致数据集转移 Quiñonero-Candela等人(2008年)。 一种常见的形式是共变移,其中输入分布会发生变化,而有条件的标签分布仍然不常变的Shimodaira(2000年);Sugiyama等人(2007年)。 在统计学习理论和实用机器学习体系中广泛研究了共变变化,方法包括重要性加权,密度比估计,以及域位适应.

blocks.en: In computer vision, distribution shift often arises from environmental changes such as sensor noise, lighting variation, blur, or weather effects. Hendrycks and Dietterich Hendrycks and Dietterich (2019) introduced the CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C benchmarks to systematically evaluate robustness under common corruptions. Subsequent work has shown that even high-performing deep networks can experience significant degradation under such shifts Taori et al. (2020) . These findings highlight the importance of developing methods that can improve robustness at deployment time.
blocks.zh: 在计算机视觉中,分布变化往往来自环境变化,如传感器噪音、照明变化、模糊或天气影响。 Hendrycks和Dietrich Hendrycks和Dietrich (2019年)介绍了CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C基准,以系统地评价常见腐败下的稳健性。 随后的研究表明,即使在高性能的深层网络在这种转变下,Taori等人(2020年)也会面临严重退化。 这些调查结果突出表明,必须制定能够提高部署时稳健性的方法。

blocks.en: Test-Time Adaptation: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has recently emerged as an effective strategy for handling distribution shifts without access to labeled target data. Instead of retraining models, TTA methods adapt the model during inference using unlabeled test samples. Early approaches introduced test-time training , where auxiliary self-supervised tasks are optimized during inference to improve robustness Sun et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 试验时间适应: 试验时间适应(TTA)最近成为处理分发转移的有效战略,没有获得标注的目标数据。 与再培训模型不同,TTA方法在推论期间使用无标签的测试样本来调整模型. 早期方法引入了测试时间培训,在推论期间优化了辅助性自我监督任务,以提高Sun等人的稳健性(2020年)。

blocks.en: More recent work focuses on adapting normalization layers or minimizing prediction entropy at test time. TENT Wang et al. (2020) updates batch normalization parameters by minimizing prediction entropy on target data and has become a widely used baseline for test-time adaptation. Several extensions have further improved TTA by incorporating consistency regularization, pseudo-labeling, or feature alignment Niu et al. (2022) ; Liang et al. (2020) . While effective, these methods require gradient-based optimization during inference and involve multiple forward-backward passes, which increases computational overhead and may introduce instability or hyperparameter sensitivity. We note that more recent CLIP-specific test-time adaptation methods based on prompt tuning also exist; we restrict our empirical comparison to TENT as a representative gradient-based baseline and discuss this scope limitation in Section 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作重点是调整常态层,或在试验时尽量减少预测 en. 腾讯王等. (2020年)通过尽量减少目标数据上的预测 en来更新批量正常化参数,并成为试验时间适应广泛使用的基线. 若干扩展方案通过纳入一致性规范化、假标签化或特征校准Niu等人(2022年);Liang等人(2020年)进一步改进了TTA。 这些方法虽然有效,但需要在推论期间进行梯度优化,并涉及多次前向后传,这增加了计算间接费用,可能带来不稳定性或超参数敏感性. 我们注意到,最近还存在基于即时调试的CLIP特定试验时间调整方法;我们仅限于将我们的经验比较作为具有代表性的梯度基准,并在第4.5节中讨论这一范围限制。

blocks.en: In contrast, our approach does not update model parameters at test time. Instead, we perform a closed-form geometric correction in feature space using Fisher information matrices. This eliminates the need for iterative optimization while preserving the predictive structure of the model.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,我们的方法并不在测试时更新模型参数. 相反,我们利用费舍尔信息矩阵在特征空间进行封闭式几何校正。 这消除了在保留模型预测结构的同时进行迭代优化的需要.

blocks.en: Feature Normalization and Whitening: Feature normalization has long been used to improve stability and generalization in deep networks. Techniques such as batch normalization Ioffe and Szegedy (2015) and layer normalization Ba et al. (2016) reduce internal covariate shift during training. At inference time, feature-space normalization and whitening have also been explored for improving robustness and domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 特性正常化和白化: 长期以来,地貌正常化被用来改善深层网络的稳定性和普遍性。 诸如批量正常化的Ioffe和Szegedy(2015年)和层层正常化的Ba等人(2016年)等技术在培训期间减少了内部共变转移。 在推论时,还探讨了地物空间正常化和白化问题,以提高稳健性和域位适应性。

blocks.en: Several works propose aligning feature distributions across domains by matching statistical moments such as mean and covariance Sun and Saenko (2016) ; Liang et al. (2020) . Whitening transformations in particular aim to remove correlations and normalize feature scales. However, such approaches treat all directions in feature space equally and ignore the predictive structure of the classifier. As a result, naive covariance whitening can distort the geometry of similarity-based classifiers and degrade performance, particularly for modern vision-language models that rely on cosine similarity between embeddings Radford et al. (2021) .
blocks.zh: 一些作品建议通过匹配诸如Sun和Saenko(2016年);Liang等人(2020年)等统计时刻来调整不同领域的特征分布。 白化变换特别旨在消除关联性,使特征尺度正常化. 然而,这类方法在特征空间中平等对待所有方向,并忽略了分类器的预测结构. 因此,天真的共变白可以扭曲基于相似性的分类器的几何学,并降解性能,特别是对于依赖嵌入式Radford等人(2021年)之间的余弦相似性的现代视觉语言模型.

blocks.en: Our work addresses this limitation by performing whitening with respect to the Fisher information matrix of the predictive distribution rather than the raw feature covariance. This preserves task-relevant directions while correcting geometric distortions caused by distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作通过对预测分布的费舍尔信息总库而不是原始特征的共性进行白化,解决了这一限制。 这保留了与任务相关的方向,同时纠正了分配转移造成的几何扭曲.

blocks.en: Training-Free and Backpropagation-Free Adaptation: Beyond gradient-based TTA, a growing line of work adapts predictions or lightweight statistics without backpropagation. T3A Iwasawa and Matsuo (2021) adjusts class prototypes using pseudo-labeled test features. LAME Boudiaf et al. (2022) refines output probabilities via a Laplacian-regularized objective over the test batch without touching the encoder. AdaNPC Zhang et al. (2023) performs non-parametric adaptation via a memory bank of test features. FOA Niu et al. (2024) searches over an input/prompt space using only forward passes. TDA Karmanov et al. (2024) and ZERO Farina et al. (2024) adapt CLIP-style models in a training-free manner using cached or test-time statistics. Unlike these methods, which adapt prototypes, outputs, or auxiliary caches, ZFGA operates directly on the feature embedding via a closed-form Fisher-geometric correction, leaving the classifier and prototypes fixed. Section 4.2 compares ZFGA against representative methods from this class directly.

T3A岩泽和松o(2021年)使用伪标签测试功能调整类原型. 莱梅 Boudiaf等人(2022年)在试验批次上通过Laplacian规范化目标改进输出概率,而不接触编码器。 AdaNPC( 达) Zhang等人(2023年)通过测试特征的存储库进行非参数适应. 基金会 尼乌等人. (2024)仅使用前传通道对输入/即时空间进行搜索. TDA Karmanov等人(2024年)和ZERO Farina等人(2024年)利用缓存或测试时间统计,以无培训方式调整CLIP型模型. 与这些改造原型,输出,或辅助缓存的方法不同,ZFGA通过封闭式的Fisher-几何校正直接运行在嵌入特性上,使分类器和原型固定下来. 第4.2节直接将ZFGA与本类的代表方法进行比较.

blocks.en: Information Geometry and Fisher-Based Methods: Information geometry provides a principled framework for analyzing statistical models using differential geometry Amari (2016) . In this framework, the Fisher information matrix defines a Riemannian metric on the manifold of probability distributions, capturing the local curvature of the model’s predictive distribution. Natural gradient methods leverage this geometry to improve optimization efficiency by preconditioning gradients with the inverse Fisher matrix Amari (2016) .
blocks.zh: 信息几何和渔业 方法:信息几何为使用微分几何Amari分析统计模型提供了一个原则框架(2016年)。 在这个框架内,Fisher信息矩阵定义了Riemannian关于概率分布的多重度量,捕捉模型预测分布的局部曲率. 自然梯度方法利用这种几何方法,通过与反向Fisher矩阵Amari(2016年)的梯度设定先决条件,提高优化效率。

blocks.en: Fisher information has also been used in several areas of deep learning, including continual learning Kirkpatrick et al. (2017) , model compression, and uncertainty estimation. However, most prior work uses the Fisher matrix to guide parameter updates during training or adaptation. In contrast, our approach applies Fisher geometry directly to feature representations at inference time. By aligning the Fisher geometry of test features with a reference distribution, we correct distortions caused by covariate shift without modifying model parameters.
blocks.zh: 费舍尔信息还被用于几个深度学习领域,包括持续学习柯克帕特里克等人(2017年),模型压缩,以及不确定性估计. 然而,大多数之前的工作都使用Fisher矩阵来指导培训或适应过程中的参数更新. 与此相反,我们的做法直接运用费舍尔几何法来说明推断时的表述。 通过使测试特征的费舍尔几何与参考分布一致,我们纠正了共变移引起的扭曲,而不修改模型参数.

blocks.en: Our method therefore connects ideas from information geometry and test-time robustness, offering a lightweight alternative to gradient-based adaptation techniques while preserving the structure of pretrained feature spaces.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的方法将信息几何学和测试时间稳健性的思想联系起来,为基于梯度的适应技术提供了轻量级的替代方法,同时保留了预先训练的特征空间的结构。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the hypothesis that ZFGA is most effective when covariate shift induces substantial geometric distortion and model robustness is limited. We test this across models and distribution shifts, supported by ablations and diagnostic analyses reported in the appendix, and explicitly identify cases where gains are small or not statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一种假设,即当共变变化诱发大量几何扭曲,模型稳健性有限时,ZFGA是最有效的. 我们通过模型和分布变化进行测试,并辅以附录中报告的描述和诊断分析,并明确找出收益小或无统计意义的情况。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models: To test the robustness-dependency hypothesis, we evaluate three models spanning a robustness spectrum: 1. ResNet-50 (non-robust): Trained from scratch on clean CIFAR-10 for 50 epochs using standard data augmentation He et al. (2016) . This model achieves ∼ \sim 94% clean accuracy but exhibits severe degradation under distribution shift. 2. DINOv3 ViT-S/16 (moderately robust): Self-supervised vision transformer pre-trained on ImageNet Caron et al. (2021) . Provides strong visual features without language supervision. 3. CLIP ViT-B/32 (highly robust): Vision-language model pre-trained on 400M image-text pairs Radford et al. (2021) . Known for exceptional robustness to distribution shift. We restrict our evaluation to these three models, spanning a coarse robustness spectrum; we have not verified whether the trends reported here hold for other architectures (e.g., other ViT scales, other self-supervised objectives, or other vision-language models), and we do not claim this small set is representative of the full robustness spectrum.

blocks.en: ResNet-50 (non-robust): Trained from scratch on clean CIFAR-10 for 50 epochs using standard data augmentation He et al. (2016) . This model achieves ∼ \sim 94% clean accuracy but exhibits severe degradation under distribution shift.

blocks.en: DINOv3 ViT-S/16 (moderately robust): Self-supervised vision transformer pre-trained on ImageNet Caron et al. (2021) . Provides strong visual features without language supervision.

blocks.en: CLIP ViT-B/32 (highly robust): Vision-language model pre-trained on 400M image-text pairs Radford et al. (2021) . Known for exceptional robustness to distribution shift.
blocks.zh: CLIP ViT-B/32(高度稳健):远景语言模型在400M图像文本配对Radford et al.(2021)上预训. 以超乎寻常的稳健性而闻名于传销转变.

blocks.en: Datasets: We use CIFAR-10-C Hendrycks and Dietterich (2019) as the primary benchmark, evaluating seven corruption types (Gaussian noise, motion blur, defocus blur, brightness, contrast, fog, and frost) spanning noise, blur, and weather/appearance categories. Results are reported for severities 2 and 3, representing moderate distribution shifts; severity 5 is analyzed separately in Appendix .5 , where severe corruption primarily destroys signal rather than inducing correctable geometric distortion. We further assess generalization on ImageNet-C using three corruption types (Gaussian Noise, Motion Blur, and Contrast) at severity 3 (Appendix .1 ). Owing to computational constraints, both evaluations use subsets of the full corruption benchmarks and should be interpreted accordingly.

blocks.en: No single method is reliable across all three model families. AdaNPC gives the largest gains on ResNet-50 ( + 4.96 % +4.96\% ) and DINO ( + 2.06 % +2.06\% , p = 0.047 p=0.047 vs. ZFGA), but degrades CLIP substantially ( − 4.19 % -4.19\% ; ZFGA significantly better, t = 16.995 t=16.995 , p = 0.0034 p=0.0034 ). LAME is harmful on all three models ( − 1.45 % -1.45\% , − 3.59 % -3.59\% , − 0.77 % -0.77\% respectively; ZFGA significantly better on ResNet, p = 0.0025 p=0.0025 , and DINO, p = 0.0036 p=0.0036 ). T3A is mixed: mildly positive on ResNet ( + 0.63 % +0.63\% ) and CLIP ( + 0.86 % +0.86\% ), but harmful on DINO ( − 1.42 % -1.42\% ; ZFGA significantly better, p = 0.0041 p=0.0041 ).

ZFGA is the only method tested that is non-negative on all three model families. Across six alternative methods evaluated in this work (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, AdaNPC), every one exhibits a substantial negative delta on at least one model, while ZFGA remains marginally positive on ResNet-50 ( + 0.72 % +0.72\% ), DINO ( + 0.14 % +0.14\% ), and CLIP ( + 0.27 % +0.27\% ). ZFGA is rarely the single best-performing method on any individual model, but is the only method in our comparison that avoids harming any of the three model families tested.

blocks.en: 4.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.5 限制

blocks.en: ZFGA assumes batch inference and corrects only second-order geometric distortions captured by the Fisher information matrix. Our evaluation is limited to three models, subsets of CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C , and primarily a single gradient-based baseline (TENT); we discuss the broader training-free comparison in 2 . Additionally, the reported distortion–benefit correlation is modest and based on limited statistical evidence, motivating broader evaluations and stronger validation in future work.
blocks.zh: ZFGA假设批量推论,只纠正了费舍尔信息矩阵捕获的二阶几何扭曲. 我们的评价限于三个模型,即CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C的子集,以及主要基于单一梯度的基线(TENT);我们讨论在2中更广泛的无培训比较。 此外,所报告的扭曲-效益关系不大,而且以有限的统计证据为基础,促使对未来工作进行更广泛的评价和加强验证。

blocks.en: We additionally note that ResNet-50’s zero-shot accuracy varied noticeably across training reruns in our pipeline (59.5%–78.3% depending on training configuration), indicating sensitivity to training setup that we have not fully isolated; all results reported in this version use a single fixed, documented training run (Section 4.1 ). As a consequence of this variability, the training-free-baseline comparison in 2 was run against an earlier checkpoint than the one used for Table 1 (its Zero-shot column reads 59.53/67.60/78.70 for ResNet/DINO/CLIP, versus 68.50/84.89/78.72 in Table 1 ); the two tables should not be read as sharing an identical zero-shot baseline until this is reconciled with a matched rerun.
blocks.zh: 我们还注意到,ResNet-50的零射线精确度在我们输油管中的重新运行中(59.5++78.3%)明显不同,这表明对培训设置的敏感性,我们尚未完全隔离;本版报告的所有结果都使用一次固定的、有记录的培训运行(第4.1节)。 由于这种变化,2个培训无底线比较比表1所用的检查点早(ResNet/DINO/CLIP的零射线栏为59.53/67.60/78.70,表1中的68.50/84.89/78.72),这两个表在与相应的重播核对之前不应理解为共用一个相同的零射线基线。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA) , a lightweight, closed-form approach for improving robustness under covariate shift by aligning the Fisher geometry of test features to a reference distribution at inference time. Unlike optimization-based test-time adaptation methods, ZFGA requires only forward passes and matrix operations.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了零训练费舍尔几何校对法(ZFGA),这是一种轻量级封闭式方法,通过将费舍尔几何测试特征与推论时的参考分布进行校对,在共变转换下提高稳健性。 与基于优化的测试时间适应方法不同,ZFGA只需要前传通行证和矩阵操作.

blocks.en: Experiments on CIFAR-10-C , and a more limited validation on ImageNet-C , show that ZFGA is never harmful and is the strongest non-gradient-based method on two of the three models tested: it improves accuracy by + 5.58 +5.58 points on ResNet-50 and + 3.31 +3.31 points on CLIP ViT-B/32, while remaining near-neutral ( + 0.08 +0.08 points) on DINOv3 ViT-S/16, where plain Fisher whitening without reference alignment performs best ( + 3.31 +3.31 ). This pattern does not track model robustness monotonically, and we do not claim that it does. A weak positive pooled correlation between Fisher geometry distortion and ZFGA gain ( r = 0.366 r=0.366 , p = 0.017 p=0.017 ) offers preliminary, confounded evidence that geometric misalignment contributes to some of the residual degradation under covariate shift.
blocks.zh: 关于CIFAR-10-C的实验和关于ImageNet-C的比较有限的验证表明,ZFGA永远不会有害,并且是测试过的三种模型中两种模型中最强的非梯度法:在ResNet-50和CLIP ViT-B/32上提高精度+5.58+5.58分,在CLIP ViT-B/32上提高3.31+3.31分,而在DINOv3 ViT-S/16上则保持近中性(+0.08+0.08分),其中平坦费舍尔白化无参考比对齐(+3.31+3.31)效果最佳. 这种模式不能单调地跟踪模型的稳健性,我们不声称它确实如此。 费舍尔几何扭曲与ZFGA增益(r = 0.366 r = 0.366,p = 0.017 p = 0.017)之间的微弱正集合关联提供了初步的,无根据的证据,证明几何错配导致一些在共变移下的剩余降解.

blocks.en: Across all evaluated settings, ZFGA remained reliably non-harmful and required no test-time optimization. We therefore view its primary contribution as a simple, deterministic, and computationally efficient alternative to optimization-based adaptation methods, particularly when reliability and deployment simplicity are prioritized over maximal performance gains.
blocks.zh: 在所有经过评价的设置中,ZFGA仍然可靠无损,不需要优化试验时间。 因此,我们认为,它的主要贡献是,它是一种简单、有决定力和计算效率的替代办法,可以取代基于优化的适应方法,特别是当可靠性和部署的简单性优先于最大限度的业绩收益时。
